 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA PRAKASH  SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 08-08-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text:
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Patrakar Nagar P.S Case No.
91/2023 dated 29.01.2023 registered for the offence punishable u/s 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 474 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66C of the I.T. Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 3. As per the prosecution case, police apprehended two persons who disclosed that they are members of cyber fraud group and they used to come here to withdraw the money from the ATM.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: On search, a motorcycle, 16 ATM cards of different banks, cheques of different banks and other paper of Bihar Govt. were recovered.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text:
Further, they disclosed that the petitioner Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35476 of 2025(2) dt.08-08-2025 and the co-accused, Suryabhushan @ Arvind is the mastermind of their group.
4.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: Nothing has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: The apprehended person disclosed the name of the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: The petitioner has no concern with the alleged occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: The other co-accused person has already been granted regular bail by this court vide order dated 08.09.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 43446/2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text:

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner by submitting that the petitioner and the co-accused person are the mastermind of this group who are giving training and doing cyber frauds.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text: 6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case as well as the material available on the record against the petitioner, I am of the view that no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Avinash Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 8 August, 2025.json

sentences.text:
The petition is disposed of and the petitioner is directed to surrender to the Court below within six Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35476 of 2025(2) dt.08-08-2025 weeks from the date of this order and the Court below may consider the prayer of the bail of the petitioner in accordance with law and on its own merits without being prejudice by this order.
7. This application is disposed of.
